title: Aokie compatibility error
description: Error body of the Aokie compatibility routes (README section 4.14), which keep FormLogic's shape so shipped clients behave as they do today: {"error":true,"code":...,"message":...} and nothing else. The phone's decoder of an error (MobileApiError) is deny_unknown_fields, so a fourth member (retryAfter, which the native shape carries) would make it lose the code and the message; the wait to honour is the Retry-After header. These codes and this shape appear on those routes only.
